questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a student learning under a skilled person?
explanation: Apprentice is correct - A-P-P-R-E-N-T-I-C-E. From Old French aprentis meaning one learning. Note the double P.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a person who rules alone?
explanation: Autocrat is correct - A-U-T-O-C-R-A-T. From Greek autos meaning self and kratos meaning power. An autocrat is a ruler with absolute power.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a city council?
explanation: Senate is correct - S-E-N-A-T-E. From Latin senatus meaning council of elders. The senate is a legislative body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning fear of water?
explanation: Hydrophobia is correct - H-Y-D-R-O-P-H-O-B-I-A. From Greek hydor meaning water and phobos meaning fear.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to breathe life into?
explanation: Animate is correct - A-N-I-M-A-T-E. From Latin anima meaning breath or soul. Animate means to bring to life.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning rule by few?
explanation: Oligarchy is correct - O-L-I-G-A-R-C-H-Y. From Greek oligos meaning few and arche meaning rule. Oligarchy means government by a small group.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to carry across?
explanation: Transport is correct - T-R-A-N-S-P-O-R-T. From Latin trans meaning across and portare meaning to carry.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a device that measures?
explanation: Barometer is correct - B-A-R-O-M-E-T-E-R. From Greek baros meaning weight and metron meaning measure. Measures atmospheric pressure.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning between nations?
explanation: International is correct - I-N-T-E-R-N-A-T-I-O-N-A-L. From Latin inter meaning between and natio meaning nation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a written account of a life?
explanation: Biography is correct - B-I-O-G-R-A-P-H-Y. From Greek bios meaning life and graphein meaning to write. The PH makes an F sound.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to make clear?
explanation: Clarify is correct - C-L-A-R-I-F-Y. From Latin clarus meaning clear and facere meaning to make. Clarify means to make something easier to understand.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning love of wisdom?
explanation: Philosophy is correct - P-H-I-L-O-S-O-P-H-Y. From Greek philos meaning loving and sophia meaning wisdom.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning against the law?
explanation: Illegal is correct - I-L-L-E-G-A-L. From Latin il meaning not and legalis meaning legal. Note the double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning one who governs a city?
explanation: Mayor is correct - M-A-Y-O-R. From Latin maior meaning greater. A mayor is the elected head of a city.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning study of the earth?
explanation: Geography is correct - G-E-O-G-R-A-P-H-Y. From Greek geo meaning earth and graphein meaning to write or describe. The PH makes an F sound.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to make new again?
explanation: Renovate is correct - R-E-N-O-V-A-T-E. From Latin renovare meaning to make new. Renovate means to restore a building to good condition.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning before the time?
explanation: Premature is correct - P-R-E-M-A-T-U-R-E. From Latin prae meaning before and maturus meaning ripe. Premature means happening too early.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a person who studies the earth?
explanation: Geologist is correct - G-E-O-L-O-G-I-S-T. From Greek geo meaning earth and logos meaning study. A geologist studies the earth.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to go back to an earlier state?
explanation: Revert is correct - R-E-V-E-R-T. From Latin revertere meaning to turn back. Revert means to return to a previous state.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning not believing in God?
explanation: Atheist is correct - A-T-H-E-I-S-T. From Greek a meaning not and theos meaning God. An atheist does not believe in God. Note the EI not IE pattern.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning rule by the people?
explanation: Democracy is correct - D-E-M-O-C-R-A-C-Y. From Greek demos meaning people and kratos meaning power or rule.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to free from blame?
explanation: Exonerate is correct - E-X-O-N-E-R-A-T-E. From Latin exonerare meaning to free from burden. Exonerate means to officially free someone from blame.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the study of the universe?
explanation: Cosmology is correct - C-O-S-M-O-L-O-G-Y. From Greek kosmos meaning universe and logos meaning study.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a thousand years?
explanation: Millennium is correct - M-I-L-L-E-N-N-I-U-M. From Latin mille meaning thousand and annum meaning year. Note double L and double N.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to agree completely?
explanation: Concur is correct - C-O-N-C-U-R. From Latin concurrere meaning to run together. Concur means to agree or happen at the same time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a list of words and meanings?
explanation: Lexicon is correct - L-E-X-I-C-O-N. From Greek lexikon meaning of words. A lexicon is a dictionary or vocabulary of a language.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the art of effective speaking?
explanation: Rhetoric is correct - R-H-E-T-O-R-I-C. From Greek rhetor meaning orator. Rhetoric means the art of effective or persuasive speaking. The H after R is silent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a change in form?
explanation: Metamorphosis is correct - M-E-T-A-M-O-R-P-H-O-S-I-S. From Greek meta meaning change and morphe meaning form.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a list of errors to be corrected?
explanation: Errata is correct - E-R-R-A-T-A. From Latin errare meaning to wander or err. Errata is the plural of erratum meaning an error in a book.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning the study of word origins?
explanation: Etymology is correct - E-T-Y-M-O-L-O-G-Y. From Greek etymon meaning true sense and logos meaning word. Etymology is the study of word origins.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to put forward for debate?
explanation: Propound is correct - P-R-O-P-O-U-N-D. From Latin proponere meaning to put forward. Propound means to put forward a theory for consideration.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a list of names?
explanation: Catalogue is correct - C-A-T-A-L-O-G-U-E. From Greek katalogos meaning a list. A catalogue is a systematic list of items.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to remove from membership?
explanation: Excommunicate is correct - E-X-C-O-M-M-U-N-I-C-A-T-E. From Latin ex meaning out and communicare meaning to share. Note double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning bad government?
explanation: Misgovernment is correct - M-I-S-G-O-V-E-R-N-M-E-N-T. From English prefix mis meaning wrong and government. Misgovernment means bad or corrupt ruling.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a formal approval?
explanation: Ratification is correct - R-A-T-I-F-I-C-A-T-I-O-N. From Latin ratus meaning fixed and facere meaning to make. Ratification means official approval.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning one who rules on behalf of another?
explanation: Regent is correct - R-E-G-E-N-T. From Latin regens meaning ruling. A regent rules on behalf of a monarch.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a person sent on a mission?
explanation: Emissary is correct - E-M-I-S-S-A-R-Y. From Latin emittere meaning to send out. An emissary is a person sent on a special mission.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning under the skin?
explanation: Hypodermic is correct - H-Y-P-O-D-E-R-M-I-C. From Greek hypo meaning under and derma meaning skin. A hypodermic needle goes under the skin.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a meeting of church leaders?
explanation: Synod is correct - S-Y-N-O-D. From Greek synodos meaning assembly. A synod is a council of church officials.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a list of events in order of time?
explanation: Chronology is correct - C-H-R-O-N-O-L-O-G-Y. From Greek chronos meaning time and logos meaning study. Chronology means the arrangement of events in time order.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the worship of many gods?
explanation: Polytheism is correct - P-O-L-Y-T-H-E-I-S-M. From Greek polys meaning many and theos meaning God. Polytheism means belief in multiple gods.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning the science of poisons?
explanation: Toxicology is correct - T-O-X-I-C-O-L-O-G-Y. From Greek toxikon meaning poison and logos meaning study. Toxicology is the study of poisons.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning outside the normal course?
explanation: Extraordinary is correct - E-X-T-R-A-O-R-D-I-N-A-R-Y. From Latin extra meaning outside and ordinarius meaning ordinary.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the art of making maps?
explanation: Cartography is correct - C-A-R-T-O-G-R-A-P-H-Y. From Latin charta meaning map and Greek graphein meaning to write. The PH makes an F sound.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the study of stars?
explanation: Astronomy is correct - A-S-T-R-O-N-O-M-Y. From Greek astron meaning star and nomos meaning law. Astronomy is the scientific study of stars.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning rule by one person?
explanation: Monarchy is correct - M-O-N-A-R-C-H-Y. From Greek monos meaning alone and arche meaning rule. Monarchy means rule by a single monarch.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning something given as a gift?
explanation: Donation is correct - D-O-N-A-T-I-O-N. From Latin donare meaning to give. Donation means something given as a charitable gift.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a love of books?
explanation: Bibliophile is correct - B-I-B-L-I-O-P-H-I-L-E. From Greek biblion meaning book and philos meaning loving. A bibliophile is a person who loves books.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the study of language?
explanation: Linguistics is correct - L-I-N-G-U-I-S-T-I-C-S. From Latin lingua meaning tongue or language. Linguistics is the scientific study of language.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning the power to act independently?
explanation: Autonomy is correct - A-U-T-O-N-O-M-Y. From Greek autos meaning self and nomos meaning law. Autonomy means the right to self-government.
